correctness.rationale: Proof uses two explicit G-invariant deletion-link decompositions, contractible cone attachments, integral augmented simplex chain identifications, the integral join Kunneth theorem, and a natural long exact sequence whose degrees prevent extensions. It checks all r boundaries including r=1 and the full simplex. The hub orientation and join Koszul signs are derived, not fitted. A fresh standard-library verifier enumerates all simplices and automorphisms for 1<=a,b<=3 and confirms 1,136 exact signed reduced Lefschetz equalities and 72 independent mod-two homology profiles. This finite check corroborates but does not prove the unrestricted theorem.

value.rationale: A complete all-parameter, fully integral automorphism-module classification for a natural three-core-vertex tree family with two distinct homology dimensions. It gives exact homological character values under all within-block permutations and the hub-exchanging involution, with a parity-sensitive upper-degree sign that cannot be deduced from already known wedge multiplicities. Both the two-degree decomposition and the involution are structurally motivated by recent work on higher-independence complexes of trees.
